reconciliation_2026_06_20.answer: Most agreed UI/behavior is PLANNED-ONLY (B2-B7 + N1-N8) — never coded. SHIPPED so far: B1 (map split-view, campaign spec edit, per-ad Book, conversation spinner), B1b (contract shape bugs), client lands on /client/spaces, '+ Ad Space', human-readable dates, new-campaign modal name fix, admin config label styling, invoice PDF (server dompdf). Everything else is backlog. A few items are PARTIAL (backend exists, UI doesn't render): 'doesn't coincide' tag + budget filter (SpaceSearchController computes, UI ignores), wallet read-only (no withdraw), mismatch-flag opens ticket but doesn't hold payout.
reconciliation_2026_06_20.already_built_not_a_gap: Provider Messages ARE linked to the conversation's space (ConversationController eager-loads space; list renders conv.space?.name). The missing piece is CONTEXTUAL per-ad/adset/campaign chat buttons (B3), not 'messages not linked'.
real_gaps_owner_hit: Provider /spaces/{id}/edit has NO availability date-ranges + Google/iCal + ? help — those live only in space-detail VIEW, not the edit form (B2 view==edit).
Client sidebar still shows Dashboard (should drop) + Collaborators still inside campaign-detail with a campaign-scoped model (needs account-scoped + Configurations tab).
All non-client dashboards show nav cards, no stats numbers.

decisions_2026_06_20: Collaborators are ACCOUNT-scoped (act across all the owner's campaigns), two ecosystems (client publicist/manager...; provider installator/manager...), subroles per ecosystem. Retire campaign_id scoping + the legacy 'proof_uploader' enum.

Proof/payment (FINAL 2026-06-20): payment is HELD from booking until the CLIENT accepts the primary proof. The CLIENT (and collaborators per role) review/accept/reject proofs — Payments does NOT review proof content. Client REJECT (or collaborator mismatch flag) -> 48h re-upload window opens for provider AND a ticket with the payment attached is created for BOTH Support AND Payments (both see it); payout stays HELD until Support+Payments agree to release. Client ACCEPT -> payment releasable, Payments MANUALLY releases (optionally auto under threshold). => remove Payments\ProofReviewController + Payments 'Proofs' nav; add 'payment' ticketable; proof-reject -> auto-hold + dual Support/Payments ticket.
Payments auto-approval = admin System Config: toggle + amount THRESHOLD (auto-release under $X), default OFF.
Invoice PDF generation = server-side (SHIPPED). Reflected in platform-graph.
All NON-client dashboards (provider/payments/support/admin) must show live stats (metrics per role in design.md Dashboards section). Client has NO dashboard.
Multi-file ads = FUTURE/deferred; MVP is ONE file per ad/space.
Booking queue = provider PICKS from the queue of pending requests for a space (marketplace stock-confirm analogy); NOT auto-assigned.
